description: C-47A-30-DL 42-23761, c/n 9623, RAF Dakota III FD901, then G-AGHM with BOAC, Skyways, BEA Pionair and Cambrian Airways, then 5B-CBD (Cyprus) 1969, withdrawn at Jeddah 1975 and derelict at Kandara airport 1981; restored in 1988, painted in Saudia colours and mounted on the famous Jeddah Airplane Roundabout at Prince Majed Street / Prince Saud Al-Faisal Street (aerialvisuals dossier; legendarymilavia blog 2019). The roundabout sculpture (design attributed to Julio Lafuente) presented it as the Dakota given to King Abdulaziz, which it is not. The roundabout was dismantled in 2019 for road works and Jeddah Municipality stated in Jan 2021 that it keeps the aircraft in Prince Majed Park (Makkah newspaper). No 2023-2026 report of it being on view in the renovated park was found; current status needs a site check.
